description: Baltimore City Freight Network is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Baltimore City’s Freight Network consists of linear features which represent the street centerlines of the official truck routes in the City of Baltimore, Maryland. The purpose of this data is to identify through, local, and restricted truck routes within Baltimore City. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are fhwa, dynamic, combination unit, bcdot, baltimore city department of transportation. The table has 80 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
